title: AI Campaign Production
description: Executable AI-assisted campaign-production prototype coordinating structured content and assets across CMS, DAM and Jira workflows.
question: How might AI coordinate campaign production while keeping exceptions, status and consequential human decisions visible?

dontMiss: Preserve the full Campaigns table → select row → in-situ split view → inspect → close → restore table interaction.
Items requiring attention should be visually prominent and actionable.
Actions that resolve a blocker should update surrounding workflow state and acknowledge success.
Campaign Production remains a control layer and wayfinder; detailed content and asset editing stays in CMS and DAM.
Human checkpoints remain visible around consequential or uncertain automated steps.
ignore: Do not turn the prototype into a replacement CMS, DAM, or AI chatbot.
Do not replace the in-situ campaign detail interaction with route-based detail pages unless explicitly requested.

title: Needs Remediation
description: Reference prototype preserving the original POC's baseline → exploration → HiFi model for a filter-header redesign.
question: How might a saved operational view explain its fixed definition without presenting that definition as removable filters?

dontMiss: One stable view name, matching navigation and breadcrumbs.
The saved view definition is copy, not a set of removable filter chips.
User-controlled filters narrow within the fixed view definition.
Existing table behaviour is preserved; the design question is the filter/header model.
ignore: Alternative explorations that did not converge
A redesign of the underlying message table
